text: RESOLVED: exact ADT. contains is exact and resolution-independent; area takes a Grid and is computed by rasterisation at a stated resolution. Rationale: exact area for arbitrary Boolean combinations of polygons needs polygon clipping (Greiner-Hormann / Vatti), ~500 lines of numerically delicate geometry for a value most analyses never read. contains is cheap and exact, and contains is what dwell time actually needs. Boolean-algebra laws tested observationally via contains on sampled points. Affects k-region, lw-region, aoi-set.
